result.brief: 通过对比灵长类视觉与图像/视频神经网络，揭示将运动渐进整合进物体表征的鲁棒动态视觉原则，并指出预测式世界模型在神经保真度与跨外观泛化上的优势。
result.reason: Compares video neural networks and predictive world models against macaque IT, analyzing appearance-invariant motion coding in visual representations—directly informing video representation learning and world models.
